search.description: Search for jobs on LinkedIn for a specific role and company. If job role and company are not provided as command-line arguments, job roles will be taken from the interested_job_role file. Fetches full job descriptions and company application links.

arguments.name: job_role
arguments.description: The job role/title to search for (e.g., 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist')

arguments.name: company
arguments.description: The company name to search jobs for

tailor_resume.description: Tailor your resume for a specific job from the searched jobs list. Analyzes match percentage between your resume and the job description. If match is below 80%, automatically removes unnecessary sections and adds relevant STAR format bullet points with realistic metrics. Generates a tailored PDF resume using LaTeX (Overleaf template).

arguments.name: serial_number
arguments.description: The serial number of the job from searched_job_list/searched_jobs.csv
